## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Financials (-1.94% 1W) and Industrials (-1.25% 1W) are both negative, and defensives (Consumer Staples and Healthcare: PG and JNJ ABOVE TREND) are leading; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%). Energy strong: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +14.24%). Consumer Staples showing defensive strength: PG ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +5.98%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -7.44%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%). Industrials weak with GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%). Technology soft overall with AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.84% | 1M: +18.53%), META RECOVERY (1W: +6.11% | 1M: -0.41%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); Style: Value/Cyclical bias given Materials and Energy strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -6.52%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%), MS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Tech.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: AMD (1W: +13.93%), GILD (1W: +12.10%), NEM (1W: +8.84%), META (1W: +6.11%). Major divergence across large caps (MSFT, GOOGL, INTC show 1W vs 1M splits) — tactical volatility likely; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak with concentrated drawdowns. NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +2.17%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -8.46%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -3.91%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -10.46%); Tech breadth: 6/19 positive — rotation away from big-cap leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are under pressure and uneven. JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.73% | 1M: -7.44%), GS CORRECTION (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +2.21%), BK CORRECTION (1W: -4.71% | 1M: +0.74%); Financials breadth: 3/20 positive — defensive posture warranted.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive tone with breadth skewed positive. UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +6.18%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +9.48%); Healthcare breadth: 10/15 positive — support for lower-beta positioning.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive and cyclical Value names (PG ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to vulnerable Financials and idiosyncratic Tech (COF BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND, AAPL BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Defensive over Growth given current risk-off posture and sector breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.93% | 1M: +20.81%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +9.56%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +28.23%). BEARISH: ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%), MS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.42%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (6/7 positive) and Energy (7/8 positive) on momentum and earnings leverage. BEARISH: Financials (3/20 positive) and Industrials (4/13 positive) as risk sentiment pressures lending and capex names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for hold/extension above recent highs (ABOVE TREND continuation), AAPL for failure to reclaim weekly resistance (AAPL BELOW TREND could press lower), UNH for breakout continuation on above-average flows (UNH ABOVE TREND), ABT for further downside if weekly support breaks (ABT BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+50): sentiment lift on AI upgrades; GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +5.86%) — bullish news but short-term weakness, partial confirmation at monthly horizon. AVGO (+50): Wells Fargo upgrade vs price AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -6.27%) — news-driven divergence, watch for follow-through. INTC (+50): upgrade headlines but INTC CORRECTION (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) — mixed confirmation given strong month but weak week.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABT (-55): Q4 miss; ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -13.04% | 1M: -13.77%) — sentiment confirmed by price. COF (-45): policy/earnings risk; COF BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -11.94%) — confirmed. INTC (-50): negative headlines also present; INTC CORRECTION (1W: -6.73% | 1M: +23.92%) — sentiment conflict with strong monthly move, monitor closely.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-OFF, Value/Defensive over Growth. UNH ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND and SLB ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL BELOW TREND and several banks (JPM, MS) show weakness. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (MSFT, GOOGL, INTC) and headline-driven downside in names like ABT — monitor news-confirmation versus price.
